snippet.title: Roguecraft DX PC Gameplay Trailer #roguelike #pixelart
snippet.description:
This is the first gameplay trailer from Roguecraft DX for PC / Steam.

We have updated the game quite a bit, going from 4:3 aspect ratio to 9:16 widescreen to fit modern screens better.

There are also quite a few new features coming in this version, including new gameplay modes that should be fun. We will be talking more about what is new in the coming weeks!

Please wishlist on Steam:  http://thalamus.link/roguecraft
 
Cthulhu fhtagn!
